title: Arirang Summer Housing Contest
bodyHtml:
[event]Arirang Summer Housing Contest



Arirang Summer Housing Contest is held!

Topic of this event is SUMMER

You must decorate summer house.


I'll check whole house and choose 5~10 house.
After then, forg members will vote best house.


One person can exhibit only one house.
Take your house screenshot  and  upload file on House Interior board .(It's on the top menu bar)

You must write topic like this->  [event]My sweet home
and write where your house is.


how to join forg
